target: Live onboarding weeks-reveal and weekly log

contract.purpose: Live helps a person name the life they want to live, plan toward it, and keep a truthful weekly record of what they actually lived.
contract.purposeSource: Owner direction on 20 September 2026 and PRODUCT.md
contract.canonicalPurpose: Live turns passive wanting into a life the user deliberately imagines, plans, and records — onboarding reveals their own weeks of a ~4,000-week life, and the weekly log asks what they did with them.
contract.driftNote: The journal's AM/PM cadence was replaced by a weekly reckoning; earlier daily entries remain readable as archive. Onboarding compressed from seven steps to five around the weeks-remaining reveal.
contract.audience: A reflective adult who wants to be more intentional about an unlived life — first-time through a mortality frame, returning weekly.
contract.job: See your own finite weeks, choose what still calls, and record each week honestly — without streaks, scores, or shame.
contract.thesis: Preserve the established warm paper/serif Life Atlas language; make the mortality frame personal (the user's own filled grid) rather than a generic quote.
contract.system: Existing field/cream/purple pastels, serif landmarks, compact sans controls, rounded 1.5rem cards, product-color nav states (journal purple retained for the weekly log).
contract.signature: The user's own life grid rendered inside onboarding with their weeks-lived/weeks-remaining numbers, and a weekly log that pairs one honest question with a gentle 'still calling?' check on quiet dreams.
contract.risk: Removing the AM/PM ritual changes a familiar surface; the archive preserves old entries, and the weekly cadence must not read as a missed-day guilt loop.

projectCheck.command: pnpm lint; pnpm typecheck; pnpm test; pnpm build; axe at 390, 768, and 1440 via e2e/daily.spec.ts a11y sweep

findings: Axe reported zero serious violations across /daily, /journal, and /habits after muted helper text moved from #8a8175 to #625b50 (3.83:1 -> >4.5:1).
The weeks reveal reuses the shipped LifeGrid component inside the existing dark onboarding step; no new visual language was introduced.
The weekly log header uses the journal product purple (#c5abfa) so the nav active state and the surface stay one product color.
Stale-dream copy was kept to 'still calling?' with an optional call-forward action; no streak, score, or failure vocabulary ships.
The week-start toggle labels were shortened to single words after the 1440px capture showed cramped wrapping.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner approved the revised product arc (issue #17); preserve lane kept the established design language so no separate visual-direction approval was required.
